subtitle.zh: 来源：nervosnetwork/ckb-cheque-script / src/entry.rs, claim.rs, withdraw.rs　·　mainnet 0xe4d4…fb0c / testnet 0x60d5…0d5b，hash_type type（RFC 0039）
subtitle.en: Source: nervosnetwork/ckb-cheque-script / src/entry.rs, claim.rs, withdraw.rs　·　mainnet 0xe4d4…fb0c / testnet 0x60d5…0d5b, hash_type type (RFC 0039)

inputs.body: Cell{ lock: SENDER(secp256k1), type: UDT?, data: amount }

outputs.label: cheque cell

role.zh: 接收方 lock script hash 前 20 字节
role.en: first 20 bytes of receiver lock hash

role.zh: 发送方 lock script hash 前 20 字节
role.en: first 20 bytes of sender lock hash

cond.zh: 创建不运行 cheque lock（lock 只在花费时执行）
cond.en: creation does not run the cheque lock (locks run only when spent)

label.zh: 接收方输入（1.b，无 cheque 签名时）
label.en: receiver input (1.b, when the cheque has no signature)

outputs.body: Cell{ lock: RECEIVER, type: UDT, data: amount }

cond.zh: 所有 cheque 输入 since = 0
Σ sender 输入 + Σ cheque 输入 = Σ sender 输出（容量原样退回发送方）
cond.en: Σ sender inputs + Σ cheque inputs = Σ sender outputs (capacity goes back to sender)

cond.zh: cheque witness 签名恢复出的 secp256k1 lock hash[0..20] = receiver
cond.en: cheque witness signature recovers to a secp256k1 lock hash[0..20] = receiver

cond.zh: 无签名时需有 lock hash[0..20] = receiver 的输入，且其 witness.lock 非空
cond.en: without signature, an input with lock hash[0..20] = receiver whose witness.lock is non-empty

title.zh: 发送方取回 withdraw（6 epoch 后）

cond.zh: 所有 cheque 输入 since = 0xA000000000000006（相对 6 epoch）
签名属于 sender，或存在 sender 输入且其 witness.lock 非空
cond.en: signature belongs to sender, or a sender input with non-empty witness.lock

notes.zh: 错误码：5 InvalidArgument · 6 NoMatchedInputs · 7 WitnessSignatureWrong · 8 SenderCapacityNotSame · 9 WrongPubKey · 10 ClaimChequeInputSinceNotZero · 11 WithdrawChequeInputSinceError · 12 Secp256k1 · 13 NoMatchedSignature（签名路径的错误都会变成 13）；1–4 为系统调用错误
notes.en: Error codes: 5 InvalidArgument · 6 NoMatchedInputs · 7 WitnessSignatureWrong · 8 SenderCapacityNotSame · 9 WrongPubKey · 10 ClaimChequeInputSinceNotZero · 11 WithdrawChequeInputSinceError · 12 Secp256k1 · 13 NoMatchedSignature (signature-path errors all surface as 13); 1–4 are syscall errors

notes.zh: 签名路径只认 secp256k1_blake160 lock（code_hash 0x9bd7…cce8, type）
notes.en: The signature path only recognizes the secp256k1_blake160 lock (code_hash 0x9bd7…cce8, type)
